answer: Every claim must hang from a vine of three verified joint jobs with three different established workers. A new identity grows its vine in the Grove, doing real shared work with established workers who stake their standing on it. The Atlas desk checks the vine within a day; a broken or borrowed vine means rejection and a forfeited 300-coin bond. A thousand fakes would need 3,000 joint jobs plus 300,000 coins in bonds. One operator spun up fifty identities; no established worker would share work with them, so every vine stayed bare and every claim died.
